note: ReAct 论文英文原版。块号对应 rag_en 库当前的切块（CHUNK_TOKENS=256）。切块参数一改，块号就会变，必须重新标注。

questions.q: Which institutions are the authors affiliated with?
questions.why: 块 0 含作者署名与单位：Princeton University 计算机系 + Google Research, Brain team

questions.q: What are the four benchmarks used to evaluate ReAct?
questions.why: 块 14 列出 HotPotQA / Fever / ALFWorld / WebShop 四个基准

questions.q: Why does the paper call chain-of-thought reasoning a static black box?
questions.why: 块 12：CoT 只用模型内部表征生成想法、不接地于外部世界，无法反应式推理或更新知识

questions.q: What is the core idea behind ReAct's action space?
questions.why: 块 17：把动作空间扩展为 Â = A ∪ L，L 是语言空间

questions.q: How does a thought differ from an action in terms of effect on the environment?
questions.why: 块 17：thought 不影响外部环境，因此没有 observation 反馈

questions.q: Which language model was used as the frozen base model for the main prompting experiments?
questions.why: 块 18：frozen large language model, PaLM-540B

questions.q: What are the three actions available in the Wikipedia API used for HotpotQA and FEVER?
questions.why: 块 22：search[entity]、lookup[string]、finish[answer]

questions.q: What browser functionality does the lookup action simulate?
questions.why: 块 22：lookup 返回页面中下一句含该字符串的话，模拟 Ctrl+F

questions.q: How many trajectories were sampled for the manual error analysis?
questions.why: 块 29：ReAct 与 CoT 各随机抽 50 条，共 200 例

questions.q: What hallucination rate did chain-of-thought show in the manual error analysis?
questions.why: 块 28 的 Table 2：Hallucination 一行，CoT 56%、ReAct 0%

questions.q: What is the most frequent failure mode specific to ReAct?
questions.why: 块 30：反复生成之前的想法和动作、陷入循环

questions.q: What was the range of relative performance gain on ALFWorld?
How many unseen evaluation games were used in ALFWorld?
questions.why: 块 35：134 unseen evaluation games

questions.q: What score and success rate did ReAct achieve on WebShop compared with the imitation learning baseline?
How many trajectories were used for the bootstrapping finetuning approach?
questions.why: 块 27：用 3000 条正确作答的轨迹微调 PaLM-8/62B

questions.q: How many CoT-SC samples does ReAct need to match CoT-SC's own performance?
questions.why: 块 31：CoT-SC 要 21 个样本，ReAct+CoT-SC 只要 3~5 个就达到同等水平

questions.q: What is the closest prior work to ReAct for interactive environments?
questions.why: 块 40：Inner Monologue (Huang et al.)

questions.q: What was ReAct's overall success rate compared with the internal-monologue-style variant on ALFWorld?
questions.why: 块 41：ReAct 71 vs ReAct-IM 53 的总体成功率

questions.q: What did the authors do to make the ReAct-versus-Act comparison a fair and controlled one?
questions.why: 块 35：Act 的提示用同一批轨迹但不含想法，任务实例随机选自训练集，两边都不占便宜。这题几乎不含可字面匹配的关键词，考的是语义召回

questions.q: What limitation do the authors acknowledge about their interactive-decision results?
questions.why: 块 40：与人类专家仍有明显差距，专家会做更多的商品探索和查询改写。同样属于低字面重叠的语义题

questions.q: What evidence does the paper offer that reasoning helps decision making rather than just question answering?
questions.why: 两处：(1) 块 15 说明稀疏推理相对纯行动基线有一致优势；(2) 块 39 给出 ALFWorld 上 33%~90% 的相对提升。标两个块是因为答案分散在不同章节，单一标注会低估检索效果

questions.q: What future directions does the conclusion suggest for improving ReAct?
questions.why: 块 47：多任务训练扩大规模、与强化学习等范式结合
